summary: Iteration 2 verified: all spelling/copy/layout changes, PATCH meal endpoint, meal.source field, edit modal flow, Sources tab protein-mix card, persistence. One BACKEND bug found: /api/analyze response is missing the 'source' field. One frontend UX limitation: delete confirmation does not appear on web preview because RN-Web Alert.alert is a no-op. Backend 15/16 pytest pass (1 intentionally-failing assertion exposing the analyze bug). Frontend 11/12 interaction checks pass.

critical.issue: AnalyzeResponse Pydantic model lacks 'source' field and extraction logic never reads data.get('source'). Gemini is correctly prompted for source, but the backend strips it. Response returns only {name, protein, emoji, note}. Must add `source: str` to AnalyzeResponse, parse/validate against ('animal','plant','supplement'), default to pick_source(name) or 'animal' on miss.

ui_bugs.component: Today's log → delete (✕) button and long-press
ui_bugs.issue: On the Expo web preview, tapping ✕ does not show a confirmation dialog and the row is not deleted. Root cause: React-Native-Web's Alert.alert is effectively a no-op in browser, so the 'Delete' button callback never executes. Will work on native iOS/Android. Suggest a Platform.OS==='web' fallback using window.confirm() inside deleteMeal for parity on web preview.

issues: Calculate button is fully visible at y≈597/844 without scroll — top whitespace reduction verified.
RN-Web console warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props deprecated — cosmetic only.

action_items: HIGH — Fix /api/analyze: add `source: str` to AnalyzeResponse; parse data.get('source'); validate in ('animal','plant','supplement'); fallback to inferred default. Frontend already consumes food.source via inferSource(food.name, food.source).
MEDIUM — Add web fallback for delete confirmation (Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm(...) : Alert.alert(...)) in deleteMeal so ✕ works on the web preview.
LOW — Address RN-Web 'shadow*' deprecation by migrating to boxShadow (cosmetic).
LOW — One legacy string 'YOUR PERSONALISED GOAL' remains in CalculatorView result card (index.tsx line 1162); replace with 'YOUR PERSONALIZED GOAL' for US-spelling consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py patch_meal correctly scopes update to {id, user_id}, clamps protein 0–300, whitelists source values, returns None for non-owner (tested).
server.py analyze_food prompts Gemini for 'source' but AnalyzeResponse schema drops it — type contract mismatch with frontend expectation.
index.tsx persists optimistic UI edit/delete to AsyncStorage AND fires PATCH/DELETE to backend — good offline resilience.
inferSource() provides a keyword-based fallback on the client, so UI works even if backend omits source — but Sources tab still depends on correct source classification.
Legacy top-tab pills completely removed from render — only bottom-bar TouchableOpacity tabs exist; `styles.topTab` is now dead code (safe to remove).
index.tsx is 1691 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting CalculatorView / SourcesView / WeekView / MonthView into /app/frontend/app/components/.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_* users in pytest (all deleted in teardown). In the live frontend run, seeded 3 meals (animal/plant/supplement) for the on-device user to validate Sources tab mix — left in DB for today's date only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://gains-log-72.preview.emergentagent.com. Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. The only expected failure is TestAnalyzeSource::test_analyze_response_includes_source until the analyze endpoint exposes 'source'. For UI delete flow, register `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` BEFORE the first click; however on Expo web this has no effect because RN-Web Alert.alert is a no-op. Sources tab shows percentages that sum to ~100% when ≥1 meal logged (verified Animal 33% + Plant 67% + Supp 0% with seeded data).
rca_of_issue: analyze 'source' bug: AnalyzeResponse model omits the field; response_model=AnalyzeResponse strips the extra key returned from parsed JSON. Fix: add `source: str = 'animal'` to AnalyzeResponse and set it in the return, validating the parsed value against the allowed set. Delete-on-web: `Alert.alert` in react-native-web does not render any UI, so the 'Delete' button's onPress is never invoked. Fix: Platform.OS==='web' branch using window.confirm for both long-press and ✕.
